macros.name: biblerefparseset
macros.doc: This sets the 〈options〉, affecting all following passage specifications in the current group.

macros.name: BRbksep
macros.doc: If a 〈passage〉 spans more than one book, the different parts are separated with \BRbksep, which you can redefine to suit your needs.

macros.name: pbibleverse
macros.doc: This parses the given 〈passage〉 and passes the result to the \bibleverse macro, formatting it according to the rules of the of the bibleref package.
